gaps.barrierBody: Records a barrier that stops this patient from attending. The type is chosen from a fixed list.
gaps.episodeBody: Starts a care episode for the patient and attaches the rules the clinic has set for that kind of episode.
gaps.episodeNotFound: The clinic, the patient or the episode code was not found. Nothing was started.
gaps.episodeNotConfigured: Episode rules are not set up yet. Nothing was started.
gaps.resolveBody: This closes the barrier, under your name. It can be done once.
gaps.alreadyResolved: This barrier was already resolved. The list will refresh.
gaps.recheckBody: This records that you re-checked the sample, under your name. It can be done once.
gaps.sameDecider: You made the decision this sample was drawn from, so someone else must re-check it. Nothing was recorded.
gaps.doneBody: Records the date this rule was last done. It can only move forward and never into the future.
gaps.dateRefused: That date is refused: it would move backwards or fall in the future. Nothing was recorded.
gaps.itemGone: That item could not be found, or it has already been dealt with. The list will refresh.

admin.title: Admin
admin.stepUp: This needs a fresh authenticator code. You will be asked for it.

accounts.note: Accounts that hold or held a role at this clinic. Only ids, a status and role words are shown; no e-mail is stored here.
accounts.empty: There are no staff accounts to show.
accounts.inviteBody: Creates an account with the one role you choose. They activate it themselves.
accounts.suspendBody: The account can no longer sign in to this system until it is reinstated.
accounts.reinstateBody: The suspended account can sign in again.
accounts.grantBody: Gives this account the role you choose at this clinic.
accounts.revokeBody: Removes the role you choose from this account at this clinic.
accounts.notConfigured: Inviting is not set up yet (no sign-in administration is configured). Nothing was sent.
accounts.exists: An account with that e-mail already exists. Grant it a role instead.
accounts.lastAdmin: That would leave the clinic without an active administrator. Nothing was changed.
accounts.cannotChange: You cannot change this account: it is your own, or you are not an administrator of every clinic where it holds a role.

autonomy.changeBody: Sets the clinic to shadow or assisted. Switching to autonomous is only done through a proposal that a second person approves.
autonomy.proposeBody: You propose as {{role}}. A different person who holds the other role must approve it within 7 days. Nothing changes until then.
autonomy.notEnabled: Switching to autonomous is not enabled yet. Nothing was changed.
autonomy.note: There is no history list: only proposals that are still pending are shown.
autonomy.decideBody: Your decision is recorded under your name by the database.

result.same_person: The person who proposed it cannot approve it.
result.wrong_role: Approval has to come from the other role.
result.not_pending: This proposal is no longer pending.

reviewer.noPolicy: The policy that judges rubber-stamping is not set, so no verdict is given.
reviewer.empty: There are no reviewer decisions in this period.

cost.note: Monthly cost from the spend ledger and completed jobs, in two columns: actual, and at the scale you plan for. A term that is not configured or not measured stays empty.

voice.note: Transcripts are read and purged only by an administrator with a fresh second factor. Every read and purge is audited by the database.
voice.readBody: The text is shown only while this window is open, and the read is audited.
voice.noChunks: There is no unexpired text in this session.
voice.keysMissing: Encryption keys are not configured, so the transcript cannot be read.
voice.purgeBody: Deletes expired transcript chunks of this clinic. An unexpired chunk is never deleted. This cannot be undone.
